## New in this release

### Improved
- **Teacher and room timetables:** while a week loads for the first time, a note below the spinner explains that this can take a while. These timetables may have to be rebuilt from every class timetable.

### Behind the scenes
- Beta releases are published as full releases and marked "Latest" automatically; only alphas are pre-releases.
